name: ApexBuffer
description: Predictive input buffer with a polished control panel. Retimes your early clicks — you still press, the mod only shifts timing. Full gameplay settings + optional help sound.

terminal-enabled.name: enable terminal
terminal-enabled.description: show the terminal button in the ApexBuffer control panel

keybinds-title.name: keybinds
keybinds-title.description: change geodes keybinding anytime for ApexBuffer

keybind-terminal.name: control panel
keybind-terminal.description: open or close the ApexBuffer control panel

ui-primary-color.name: primary color
ui-primary-color.description: primary gradient color for the panel

ui-secondary-color.name: secondary color
ui-secondary-color.description: secondary gradient color for the panel

ui-surface-color.name: surface color
ui-surface-color.description: background color of the panel card

ui-text-color.name: text color
ui-text-color.description: color used for all panel text

ui-glow.name: glow
ui-glow.description: draw a soft accent glow behind the panel

ui-panel-scale.name: panel scale
ui-panel-scale.description: adjust the overall size of the control panel

ui-font-scale.name: font scale
ui-font-scale.description: adjust the text size in the control panel

mobile-floating-button.name: floating af button
mobile-floating-button.description: also show the draggable af button on screen. the pause menu button is always there

help-sound.name: help sound
help-sound.description: Play a short sound when ApexBuffer saves/retimes an input for you.

practice-only.name: practice mode only
practice-only.description: Only buffer inputs in practice mode. Off = also in normal runs.

smart-prediction.name: orb / pad / portal prediction
smart-prediction.description: Let the ghost use orbs, pads, gravity and speed portals.

sim-budget-ms.name: prediction time budget (ms)
sim-budget-ms.description: Max time spent predicting per click. Higher finds longer saves but may hitch.

ground-horizon.name: cube / ball lookahead (ticks)
ground-horizon.description: How far ahead cube/ball/spider prediction looks.

wave-horizon.name: wave lookahead (ticks)
wave-horizon.description: How far ahead wave prediction looks (mini wave uses a bit less).

wave-auto-release.name: wave auto-release
wave-auto-release.description: While you hold in wave, if holding would crash soon and releasing survives, release for you. Practice only unless normal-runs is on.

auto-release-window.name: auto-release window (ticks)
auto-release-window.description: Hold must die within this many ticks to auto-release.

ship-buffer.name: ship buffer
ship-buffer.description: Also buffer ship presses and releases.

low-latency.name: low latency mode
low-latency.description: Shorter searches and smaller delays — less lag feel, fewer long saves.

wave-safety-margin.name: wave safety margin
wave-safety-margin.description: Prefer a wave delay with a little room on both sides, not the razor-edge tick.

show-path.name: show prediction path
show-path.description: Draw the ghost path when a save is found (if supported in this build).

explain-inputs.name: explain inputs (log)
explain-inputs.description: Log more detail about passes and skips to the panel/terminal log.

avoid-moving-objects.name: avoid moving objects
avoid-moving-objects.description: Do not trust a save if the ghost path crosses moving objects.

wave-spam-gap.name: wave spam max gap (ticks)
wave-spam-gap.description: Inputs closer than this count toward spam (then may pass through unbuffered).
